title: The Promise of Eternal Life
definition: The Promise of Eternal Life is God's gift of everlasting life to all who believe in Jesus Christ.
summary: The Promise of Eternal Life is God's assurance that those who believe in Christ will live with Him forever.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the resurrection and the life, giving eternal life to His sheep.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The promise of eternal life is God's assurance that those who believe in Christ will live with Him forever. Scripture presents eternal life as both a present possession and a future inheritance.

Eternal life is more than endless existence. It is knowing God through Jesus Christ, sharing His life now, and awaiting resurrection fullness in the age to come.

Jesus is the giver and guarantee of eternal life. Because He lives, His people will live also.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because death, suffering, and uncertainty can make life feel fragile and temporary. The promise of eternal life anchors believers in Christ's victory rather than the world's fading hopes.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Hold earthly life with gratitude but not desperation. Comfort the grieving, strengthen the fearful, and live today as someone whose future is secured by the risen Christ.
